Class ReviewerRatingPage

java.lang.Object
application.ReviewerRatingPage
public class ReviewerRatingPage extends Object
Creates the page for allowing students to create reviews of reviewers. Includes assigning scores and selecting if they are trusted.

    • setUpReviewedVBox

      public javafx.scene.layout.VBox setUpReviewedVBox(ArrayList<ReviewerRating> ratingList, javafx.stage.Stage primaryStage, User user)
      Puts all userName's inside ratingList into VBox. Contains necessary components to allow user to increase/decrease reviewers score and select whether they are trusted. Performs this for every reviewer name in list.
      Parameters:
      ratingList - List of of strings containing reviewer userNams.
      primaryStage - Passes the current stage being used.
      user - Passes the current user object.
      Returns:
      VBox This will contain all components for each userName in ratingList.
